title: Miraculous Rescue: Young Child Pulled From 15-Meter Well in Iran
text:
Miraculous Rescue: Young Child Pulled From 15-Meter Well in Iran"

"SABZEVAR, Razavi Khorasan Province, Iran — Sept. 15"

"A young child was rescued from the bottom of a 15-meter (about 49-foot) well in Sabzevar, the Sabzevar Fire Department said."

"Hamati, head of public relations for the Sabzevar Fire Department, said the incident was reported to the 125 emergency command center at 2:36 p.m. local time. A fire department rescue team was dispatched to the scene and began using specialized rescue equipment to reach and extract the child."

"After completing the rescue operation, firefighters brought the child up from the 15-meter well and handed the child over to emergency medical personnel for examination and treatment."

"Source: Iran’s State TV
